query: kornia 0.8.3 removed the accidental re-export of torch's `pad` from kornia.geometry.transform.pyramid, so the whole node pack fails to import and every dependent workflow breaks.

desired.outcome: kornia maintainer (ducha-aiki) confirmed cause and that the fix belongs in this repo (PRs #498/#506/#516): drop `pad` from the kornia import and use `pad = F.pad` (confirmed by MartinT23); alternative confirmed workaround: pin kornia==0.8.2 (dadleo).
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Same as #541: diagnose kornia 0.8.3's dropped `pad` re-export and either patch the import in-repo or pin kornia==0.8.2.
